justification: Brown's tagged Out, not Doubtful, not Questionable — that's the one tag that actually sits a man, no eulogy, no debate. Kincaid's healthy, off a bye, and projects over every other body standing on this bench, so he slides into flex and plays instead of sitting dead weight for sentiment's sake. Caleb doesn't sit for any reason, ever — 18.4 on paper is a floor, I've watched him post better behind worse blocking. Jeanty and Judkins stay up top because they're the backs who take the top off a defense, not committee guys splitting carries into nothing. Downs and Burden earned their snaps last week and nobody's benching production to redecorate a house that isn't on fire. Goedert, Reichard, and Detroit round it out because they're not broken either. Taylor wants to talk character and empty scoreboards — fine, let's see whose scoreboard's actually empty come Sunday night.
